parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty members array and all structural_evidence fields (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count) are null, meaning no concrete field overlap or shape similarity was actually surfaced. The two participating types — Show__Artwork in Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/_Plant_ShowContainer.swift and Discogs.Release in Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift — belong to distinct domain concepts (a playback show container versus a Discogs music-release record), and without grounded field-level evidence any structural resemblance is coincidental. Recommending a refactor without evidence would risk conflating unrelated domain models.
